decisiveFinding.implication: the §6.4 fixture-state regression class is UNSUPPORTED-DEPLOYED-CONFIG — enabling it requires a Railway env mutation + redeploy of staging (SAFETY_STATE_FIXTURE=1), a materially heavier operation than PostHog flag flips because it cycles the service for all users. Decision #110 authorized regression; whether fixture enablement on shared staging is in scope is an owner call — filed for the record rather than assumed.
decisiveFinding.positiveEvidence: the engine endpoint itself is live and evaluating on staging: every probe returned well-formed INSUFFICIENT_DATA/ALLOW decisions with correct structure — the evaluation pipeline works; only fixture seeding is gated
